premises.text: Presentations are not fully integrated into the cloud and suffer from version control issues.
premises.evidence_span: Presentations are one of the last business tools that hasn't fully made it in the cloud. Today, people are creating their presentation in PowerPoint, sharing it via email, having a conversation about it on Slack. Someone uploads it to Dropbox or Google Drive. Someone else has the wrong version of PowerPoint.
